additional_contracts: Observable custom Clone is bypassed by trivial policy; existing DynamicArray::clone still invokes Clone.
Domain failures reject retained destination or mismatched stride before allocation/copying; destination values remain unchanged.
Failure token survives destination Drop, retains readable prefix and original allocator, and reclaims exactly that block on Drop.
Rust callback panic reclaims the incomplete block immediately, matching prior Rust behavior; modeled native constructor errors use Result and retained ownership.
Failure metadata exposes native-style Failure details plus Debug/Display/Error source; validation failures carry no incomplete block.
known_limits: Native leaks the unpublished allocation on constructor throw. Rust returns a reachable recovery owner and ordinary token Drop cleans it. Parity covers the pre-cleanup observable state and explicit matched recovery; indefinite leaks/native exception propagation are not claimed.

Constructor errors must be returned as Err to request the native failure policy. Rust panics use RAII cleanup and are deliberately outside that policy. Generic Clone is not asserted to reproduce arbitrary C++ copy-constructor side effects.
Destination must be unallocated and source/destination stride equal, with every logical source value physically initialized. Other native metadata-only or retained-destination cases are not credited.

Allocation failure, pointer-vector allocation failure, address-dependent placement constructors, implicit C++ relocation hooks, and destructor-unwind/noexcept termination behavior remain outside the modeled domain.

Bitwise policy is explicitly selected using Rust Copy for soundness; Rust traits do not automatically infer OCCT C++ traits. No ZST/native sizeof-layout equivalence or global allocator byte-for-byte ABI claim.
The recovery Failure detail is boxed to keep Result small; this Rust metadata allocation is separate from native element-block allocation counts.
Protected retained-block copyParameters remains a bounded zero-block adapter pending compatible allocator/stride/lifetime policy work.
The17 rows are supplemental native behavior probes. All52 original mappings are rerun, not newly credited; no global coverage inflation.
